                  bsp_Init_RTCIRQ PROC
;;;16     
;;;17     void bsp_Init_RTCIRQ(void)  
000000  b50e              PUSH     {r1-r3,lr}
;;;18     {
;;;19         EXTI_InitTypeDef EXTI_InitStructure;
;;;20         NVIC_InitTypeDef NVIC_InitStructure;
;;;21         
;;;22         /* GPIOB.5 中断线配置 IRQ0 */
;;;23       	GPIO_EXTILineConfig(GPIO_PortSourceGPIOB,GPIO_PinSource5);
000002  2105              MOVS     r1,#5
000004  2001              MOVS     r0,#1
000006  f7fffffe          BL       GPIO_EXTILineConfig
;;;24         /* GPIOB.5 中断初始化配置 */
;;;25       	EXTI_InitStructure.EXTI_Line = EXTI_Line5;
00000a  2020              MOVS     r0,#0x20
00000c  9001              STR      r0,[sp,#4]
;;;26       	EXTI_InitStructure.EXTI_Mode = EXTI_Mode_Interrupt;	
00000e  2000              MOVS     r0,#0
000010  f88d0008          STRB     r0,[sp,#8]
;;;27       	EXTI_InitStructure.EXTI_Trigger = EXTI_Trigger_Falling;
000014  200c              MOVS     r0,#0xc
000016  f88d0009          STRB     r0,[sp,#9]
;;;28       	EXTI_InitStructure.EXTI_LineCmd = ENABLE;
00001a  2001              MOVS     r0,#1
00001c  f88d000a          STRB     r0,[sp,#0xa]
;;;29         /*根据EXTI_InitStruct中指定的参数初始化外设EXTI寄存*/
;;;30       	EXTI_Init(&EXTI_InitStructure);
000020  a801              ADD      r0,sp,#4
000022  f7fffffe          BL       EXTI_Init
;;;31     	
;;;32         /*使能按键所在的外部中断通道*/
;;;33       	NVIC_InitStructure.NVIC_IRQChannel = EXTI9_5_IRQn;
000026  2017              MOVS     r0,#0x17
000028  f88d0000          STRB     r0,[sp,#0]
;;;34         /*设置抢占优先级，抢占优先级设为2*/	
;;;35       	//NVIC_InitStructure.NVIC_IRQChannelPreemptionPriority = 0x02;	
;;;36         /*设置子优先级，子优先级设为2*/
;;;37       	NVIC_InitStructure.NVIC_IRQChannelSubPriority = 0x01;		
00002c  2001              MOVS     r0,#1
00002e  f88d0002          STRB     r0,[sp,#2]

;;;39       	NVIC_InitStructure.NVIC_IRQChannelCmd = ENABLE;	
000032  f88d0003          STRB     r0,[sp,#3]
;;;40         /*根据NVIC_InitStruct中指定的参数初始化外设NVIC寄存器*/	
;;;41       	NVIC_Init(&NVIC_InitStructure);

000038  f7fffffe          BL       NVIC_Init
;;;42     }
00003c  bd0e              POP      {r1-r3,pc}
;;;43     
                          ENDP
